facts.text: Ladera was built by hand between Saint Lucia's Pitons and sits within the Pitons UNESCO World Heritage site.
facts.excerpt: Built by hand between Saint Lucia’s legendary Pitons, Ladera is the only resort within this UNESCO World Heritage site.

facts.text: Ladera is Green Globe certified.
facts.excerpt: Green Globe certified, it’s a place to reconnect

facts.text: Each villa and suite is hand-crafted from local wood, stone and tile with St. Lucian artistry.
facts.excerpt: Hand-crafted from local wood, stone and tile with St. Lucian artistry

facts.text: Every villa and suite has a heated plunge pool and a view of the Pitons through Ladera's three-wall design.
facts.excerpt: each has a heated plunge pool and breathtaking view of the Pitons courtesy of our pioneering three-wall design

facts.text: The Villa at Paradise Ridge sits at the highest point at Ladera.
facts.excerpt: The Villa at Paradise Ridge sits at the highest point at Ladera.

facts.text: Villa La Fleur is a two-level, two-bedroom, air-conditioned villa with a Great Room whose floor-to-ceiling glass doors open onto a covered veranda.
facts.excerpt: the two-level, two bedroom Villa La Fleur is a luxurious, air-conditioned retreat featuring a 900-square-foot Great Room with floor-to-ceiling glass doors that seamlessly connect with a ten-foot covered veranda

facts.text: Villa La Fleur guests can book a private chef who cooks locally inspired menus in the villa's commercial-grade kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Our chefs will craft exquisite, locally inspired menus, personalized and cooked before you in Villa La Fleur’s commercial grade kitchen

facts.text: La Petite Fleur offers a closed fourth wall option with air conditioning.
facts.excerpt: La Petite Fleur also offers a closed 4th wall option with air conditioning.

facts.text: Hilltop Dream Suites have a private heated pool and a romantic swing for two.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the private heated pool and a romantic swing for two.

facts.text: Hilltop Dream Suites include a private butler.
facts.excerpt: Your private butler ensures that your every need is effortlessly met.
